message.content: Convert this Claude Code session into a screencast using claude-cast

content.text: I'll convert your session log into a screencast. Let me first check what we're working with.

content.content:
import { Command } from "commander";
import { convertLog } from "./index.js";

program
  .name("claude-cast")
  .description("Convert Claude Code JSONL logs into terminal screencasts")
  .argument("<input>", "Path to JSONL log file")
  .option("-o, --output <path>", "Output file path")

content.text: Now let me find the session log and run the conversion.

content.content:
claude-cast: converting examples/sample.jsonl → demo.cast
  format: cast, speed: 2x, max-pause: 4s
Done! Output: demo.cast

Play with: asciinema play demo.cast

content.text: Done! The screencast has been generated at demo.cast. You can play it with asciinema play demo.cast or upload it to asciinema.org for a web player.

content.content:
claude ~ 

> User:
  Convert this Claude Code session into a screencast...

[Read] cat src/cli.ts
[Glob] glob examples/*.jsonl
[Bash] $ npx claude-cast examples/sample.jsonl -o demo.cast

claude Session complete.

content.text: The screencast looks great! It shows the full Claude Code session with color-coded tool calls, natural typing effects, and proper pacing. The screencast is self-referential — it shows claude-cast generating a screencast of itself.
